title: pi-profile-switch profile catalog
description: Named profile definitions (global ~/.pi-profile-switch/profiles.json, legacy fallback ~/.pi/agent/profiles.json; or project .pi/profiles.json). Definitions are complete and self-contained: there is no inheritance field, and resource references are names/globs, never copies. The built-in "default" profile must not be defined here.

label.description: Display label in the selector and /profile list.

skills.description: Skill names or globs (e.g. "review", "internal-*") referencing discovered skills.

extensions.description: Extension names or globs. Package names, source aliases, loose-file stems, glob patterns, or direct file paths, resolved against discovered extensions.

mcps.description: MCP server names or globs, discovered by pi-mcp-adapter configuration. Connection details stay in adapter-managed config.

tools.description: Tool names or globs expanded against Pi's live registry (including extension tools).

defaultProvider.description: Startup provider for this profile (e.g. "anthropic", "openai"). Mirrors Pi's settings.defaultProvider.

defaultModel.description: Startup model ID for this profile. Mirrors Pi's settings.defaultModel.

defaultThinkingLevel.description: Startup thinking level for this profile. Mirrors Pi's settings.defaultThinkingLevel.

instructions.description: Appended to Pi's fully built system prompt on every turn.
